purpose: Reference-only readiness assessment for DMI and ADG component datasets.

domainExpertReview.statement: Nenhum parecer zootécnico independente foi realizado; a classificação de yearlings como adultos permanece pendente.
domainExpertReview.attributionNote: A definição da pergunta exploratória foi aprovada pelo responsável do projeto; isso não é parecer de especialista. A issue #22 acompanha a revisão independente.

sources.name: USDA/CPER foraging behavior and weight gains
sources.population: Yearling cattle on semi-arid Colorado rangeland; adult classification is unresolved.
sources.units: Animal-period ADG in kg/day; DMI is not present.
sources.missingness: See linked audit report; source has repeated animal-period observations.

dmi.reason: No individual DMI outcome is present.

adg.reason: Suitable only for the approved exploratory association/component scope; yearling classification, observational design and repeated animal keys constrain generalization.

sources.permissibleUse: Exploratory observational ADG/pastejo analysis; no causal claim, adult-cow claim, or full-engine validation.

sources.name: USDA/CPER long-term grazing intensity weight gains
sources.population: Yearling cattle (heifers and steers) managed under grazing intensities, 2000–2019.
sources.units: One animal-season row; entry/exit weights converted to kg; derived ADG kg/day.
sources.missingness: Exclusions, repeated keys and measurement protocol changes are described in the audit report.

dmi.reason: No individual DMI outcome is present.

adg.reason: Public individual seasonal gain supports a bounded ADG component diagnostic; it is not a daily trajectory or replicated causal treatment experiment.

sources.permissibleUse: Bounded ADG component assessment with year/pasture/animal key discipline; not full-engine or causal treatment validation.

sources.name: Dryad finishing steers methane-model dataset
sources.population: Finishing/feedlot beef steers across five experiments.
sources.units: One animal-by-experiment summary row; DMI and ADG in kg/day.
sources.missingness: The linked audit reports 446 complete outcome rows; no daily paired trajectory.

dmi.reason: Open individual experiment-level DMI is usable for a fixed-default finishing component diagnostic, but not pasture transfer or full-engine validation.

adg.reason: ADG is reported for the same finishing cohort, but it is not the approved pasture population and is a phase summary.

sources.permissibleUse: Limited finishing/feedlot component assessment; keep experiment IDs grouped and do not transfer conclusions to grazing.

sources.name: SDSU individual DMI on rangeland

sourceIdentity.license: CC BY (manifest article/supplement; see source-specific evidence)

sources.population: Rangeland grazing cohort described in the linked audit; verify eligibility for any target population before use.
sources.units: Derived DMI kg/day from intake pounds and period mean dry-matter percentage; see manifest derivation.
sources.missingness: Rows without forage matching are retained with derived DMI blank; see audit and manifest.

dmi.reason: Local source and derivation are available, but derived intake and population/period limitations require a component-only interpretation.

adg.reason: The paired source/audit does not establish an approved ADG outcome for the target use.

sources.permissibleUse: DMI component diagnostic under the documented derivation; no claim of complete pasture-engine validation.

sources.name: GrASTech dairy grazing DMI
sources.population: Lactating dairy cows in a grazing supplementation experiment.
sources.units: See audit report; linked workbooks hold animal, period, feed and herbage measures.
sources.missingness: Use workbook-level missingness and coverage in the linked audit; not copied into this matrix.

dmi.reason: Individual grazing-intake evidence is available, but dairy population and study-specific measurement limit transfer to beef cattle.

adg.reason: The cited audit does not establish an approved paired ADG target for this assessment.

sources.permissibleUse: Dairy grazing DMI component analysis only; do not treat it as beef-cattle validation.

sources.name: USDA-ARS individual feedlot DMI
sources.units: Individual feedlot DMI and supporting fields as listed in the audit.
sources.missingness: See linked audit report; do not infer missing values from publication summaries.

dmi.reason: Open feedlot DMI can support a feedlot component assessment, not a pasture-DMI claim.

adg.reason: Performance association is not sufficient by itself to establish a paired approved ADG validation target.

sources.permissibleUse: Feedlot DMI component analysis within dataset license and attribution terms.

sources.name: Dryad grazing yearling steers
sources.units: One ADG and body-weight record per steer; visits are interval records.
sources.missingness: The audit reports 154 model rows; DMI and experiment ID are absent, and visit coverage is incomplete for some animals.

adg.reason: Open ADG and BW support a descriptive yearling reference; no experiment ID or paired starting/ending weights for this use.

sources.permissibleUse: Separate yearling ADG descriptive reference only; no full-engine validation or adult-cow inference.

sources.name: Rothamsted dairy-cross beef grazing
sources.population: Young growing dairy-cross beef cattle in temperate pasture; not a mature-cow cohort.
sources.units: Animal-period daily liveweight gain kg/steer/day; repeated periods per official tag.
sources.missingness: Integrity, coverage and cohort details are in the linked audit report.

dmi.reason: No individual DMI outcome is present.

adg.reason: Open repeated animal-period ADG supports a bounded component diagnostic, but its population and predictors differ from the approved CPER case.

sources.permissibleUse: Held-out cohort ADG component diagnostic only; not full-engine or adult-cow validation.

sources.name: Angus cows on dormant-season rangeland

sourceIdentity.license: CC-BY-4.0 (manifest/article supplement; inspect data terms before redistribution)

sources.population: Pregnant commercial Angus cows, ages 1–10, on dormant mixed-grass rangeland.
sources.units: Cow-season weight change; ADG is derived over a study-reported 84-day period.
sources.missingness: Audit reports missing weight/BCS changes; 167 cow IDs recur across years, and GPS covers a subset/45 days.

dmi.reason: Total forage DMI is not observed; supplement intake is not total DMI.

adg.reason: Derived period weight change can serve as a descriptive cow-season reference, not verified daily ADG or an engine prediction target.

sources.permissibleUse: Descriptive period-change reference with year+animal grouping and missingness disclosure.

sources.name: Public pasture DMI candidates with no reusable individual records found

sourceIdentity.license: Underlying-data reuse license/access not established for the cited candidates.

sources.population: Candidate sources include adult beef cattle on pasture; assess each source separately if access/terms change.
sources.units: No individual-level reusable outcome file was retrieved for these candidates.
sources.missingness: Individual observations are unavailable; article summaries are not a substitute.

dmi.reason: Underlying records are private, inaccessible, absent, or not data-specifically licensed; inaccessible sources are never counted as trainable.

adg.reason: No usable individual ADG records with the required paired inputs were retrieved.

sources.permissibleUse: Literature/methods context and access follow-up only; do not reconstruct microdata from tables or figures.
